hardware_caveat: GPU allocation mixes H100 NVL and L40S; native and square-padding base runs are not hardware matched. Numerical equivalence to Google's executing environment is not established.

metric_definitions.accuracy: Correct labels / all original row occurrences; NSE and invalid outputs are incorrect.
metric_definitions.mean_finding_class_balanced_accuracy: Unweighted mean of each finding's mean per-change-class recall. All five findings retained.
metric_definitions.pooled_class_balanced_accuracy: Mean per-change-class recall after pooling all finding rows.
metric_definitions.published_macro_accuracy_caveat: Neither balanced-accuracy bridge is asserted to reproduce Google's unavailable aggregation code.
metric_definitions.supported_macro_f1: Unweighted mean F1 across improving/stable/worsening only; no zero-support NSE class added.
metric_definitions.zero_support_bootstrap_policy: A zero-gold-support class is omitted from that bootstrap replicate's recall mean; macro-F1 retains the fixed three classes.

output_contracts.bridge_limits: Interface bridges change multiple prompt/output/preprocessing details together; they do not isolate one causal factor. Original historical generation exports lack image paths; canonical occurrence order and source/pair/patient/finding/gold were checked. BioViL-T classifier export retains source/finding/gold but lacks pair/patient fields. Historical EOS and truncation are unavailable.
output_contracts.historical: Historical four-label canonical-label interface with system instruction, NSE permitted and 16-token cap for prompt-only; retain historical parsed labels. Adapter-specific historical generation provenance is in internal_manifest.json.
output_contracts.new_native_and_padding: User-only, explicit prior/current image annotations, three-option MCQ, no NSE, greedy decoding, 128-token cap, strict whole-response parser.

selection_statement: The prompt, both preprocessing configurations and all five passes were fixed before new outcomes; no test-outcome prompt selection.
